knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# data wrangling
library(tidyr)

# data vis
library(ggplot2)

# Make a more compact plot: complex heatmap again!

```{r read.combined.ORs.qs}
microbe_ORs = read.csv("data/sig_logit_all_ors_rarefied.csv")
q_values = read.csv("data/sig_logit_all_qs_rarefied.csv")

rownames(microbe_ORs) = microbe_ORs$plot_name
microbe_ORs$plot_name <- NULL
microbe_ORs$feature <- NULL

rownames(q_values) = q_values$plot_name
q_values$plot_name <- NULL
q_values$feature <- NULL
```

```{r sort.rename.cols}
microbe_ORs_sorted <- microbe_ORs[order(microbe_ORs[, "abx_three"],
                                            decreasing = TRUE), ]
rename_vec <-  c(
    abx_three = "Antibiotics last 0 - 3 months",
    abx_twelve = "Antibiotics last 3 - 12 months",
    meds_cholesterol   = "Cholesterol lowering med use",
    meds_blood_sugar  = "Blood sugar lowering med use"
  )

colnames(microbe_ORs_sorted) <- recode(colnames(microbe_ORs_sorted),
                                         !!!rename_vec)
```

```{r set.up.significance}
# Significance annotation logic
stars <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("")
  if (p < 0.001) return("***")
  if (p < 0.01)  return("**")
  if (p < 0.05)  return("*")
  if (p < 0.1)  return("#")
  return("")
}
```

```{r, define.color.columns}
OR_cols <- c("Antibiotics last 0 - 3 months",
               "Antibiotics last 3 - 12 months", 
               "Cholesterol lowering med use",
               "Blood sugar lowering med use")

### Create matrix
OR_matrix <- as.matrix(microbe_ORs_sorted[, OR_cols])
rownames(OR_matrix) <- rownames(microbe_ORs_sorted)

q_matrix <- as.matrix(q_values)
qval_mat <- q_matrix[rownames(microbe_ORs_sorted), ]
```


```{r colors.annotations}
phyla_colors <- c(
  "Actinobacteria"   = "#9400D3",
  "Bacteroidetes"    = "#FF8C00",
  "Cyanobacteria"    = "#00FFE2",
  "Firmicutes"       = "#4682B4",
  "Fusobacteria"     = "#DC143C",
  "Lentisphaerae"    = "#C1AD09",
  "Patescibacteria"  = "#FF69B4",
  "Proteobacteria"   = "#33a02c",
  "Tenericutes"      = "#FFFF00",
  "Verrucomicrobia"  = "#A0522D"
  )

anno_phyla <- microbe_ORs_sorted$Phylum           # categorical
anno_prevalence <- microbe_ORs_sorted$prevalence  # continuous

cont_colors <- colorRamp2(c(min(anno_prevalence, na.rm = TRUE),
                            median(anno_prevalence, na.rm = TRUE),
                            max(anno_prevalence, na.rm = TRUE)),
                          c("lightgrey", "dimgrey", "black"))

or_col_fun   <- colorRamp2(c(0.5, 1, 3), c("#008080", "white", "#800000"))

row_anno <- rowAnnotation(
  Prevalence = anno_prevalence,
  Phylum = anno_phyla,
  col = list(
    Prevalence = cont_colors,
    Phylum = phyla_colors),
  simple_anno_size = unit(3, "mm"),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.1)
)
```

```{r, fig.height=19, fig.width=5}
ht_ORs <- Heatmap(OR_matrix,
                   name = "OR",
                   heatmap_legend_param = list(
                     title = "Odds Ratio",
                     title_position = "topleft"),
                   left_annotation = row_anno,
                   col = or_col_fun,
                   na_col = "lightgrey",
                   column_names_rot = 45,
                   column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                   column_gap = unit(2, "mm"),
                   cluster_rows = FALSE,
                   cluster_columns = FALSE,
                   show_row_names = TRUE, 
                   row_names_side = "left", 
                   row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
                   rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.2),
                   height = unit(nrow(microbe_ORs_sorted) * 3.5, "mm"),
                   cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
                     pval <- qval_mat[i, j]
                     star <- stars(pval)
                     grid.text(star, x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, col = "black"))}
                   )
ht_ORs 
```

```{r save.fig.not.imp}
pdf("figures/microbe_heatmap_logit_vendor_rarefied.pdf",
    width = 5, height = 19)
draw(ht_ORs)
dev.off()
```

# For our first try: forest plots

## Read in CSV files of logistic regression results

Note that this expects a table with columns:
- plot_name (taxa)
- OR
- OR_conf_low
- OR_conf_high
- Phyla (for coloring)
- prevalence_bins (for breaking into subplots)

```{r load.data}
three_logit = read.csv('data/sig_logit_three_w_phyla.csv')
twelve_logit = read.csv('data/sig_logit_twelve_w_phyla.csv')
chol_logit = read.csv('data/sig_logit_chol_w_phyla.csv')
sugar_logit = read.csv('data/sig_logit_sugar_w_phyla.csv')
```

## Set colors

```{r colors}
phyla_colors <- c(
  "Actinobacteria"   = "#9400D3",
  "Bacteroidetes"    = "#FF8C00",
  "Cyanobacteria"    = "#00FFE2",
  "Firmicutes"       = "#4169E1",
  "Fusobacteria"     = "#DC143C",
  "Lentisphaerae"    = "#C1AD09",
  "Patescibacteria"  = "#FF69B4",
  "Proteobacteria"   = "#33a02c",
  "Tenericutes"      = "#A9AAAA",
  "Verrucomicrobia"  = "#A0522D"
  )
```

## Reorder data by odds ratio

```{r three.reorder.OR}
three_logit_sorted_desc <- three_logit[order(three_logit$OR), ]

three_logit_sorted_desc$plot_name <- factor(
  three_logit_sorted_desc$plot_name,
  levels = three_logit_sorted_desc$plot_name
)
```

```{r twelve.reorder.OR}
twelve_logit_sorted_desc <- twelve_logit[order(twelve_logit$OR), ]

twelve_logit_sorted_desc$plot_name <- factor(
  twelve_logit_sorted_desc$plot_name,
  levels = twelve_logit_sorted_desc$plot_name
)
```

```{r chol.reorder.OR}
chol_logit_sorted_desc <- chol_logit[order(chol_logit$OR), ]

chol_logit_sorted_desc$plot_name <- factor(
  chol_logit_sorted_desc$plot_name,
  levels = chol_logit_sorted_desc$plot_name
)
```


```{r sugar.reorder.OR}
sugar_logit_sorted_desc <- sugar_logit[order(sugar_logit$OR), ]

sugar_logit_sorted_desc$plot_name <- factor(
  sugar_logit_sorted_desc$plot_name,
  levels = sugar_logit_sorted_desc$plot_name
)
```


## Plot significant hits between none v. three month group

```{r plot.all.vertical, fig.height=16, fig.width=10}
base_plot <- ggplot(three_logit_sorted_desc) +
  geom_point(aes(x = OR, y = plot_name, color = Phylum),
             # position = position_dodge2(width = 0.5),
             size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = OR_conf_low, xmax = OR_conf_high,
                    y = plot_name, 
                    color = Phylum),
                #position = position_dodge2(width = 0.5),
                width = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Odds Ratio", y='', color = "Phyla") +
  theme(legend.position = "top", 
        legend.text = element_text(size = 11)) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = phyla_colors)
base_plot
```

```{r get.legend}
legend <- get_legend(base_plot)
legend_plot <- wrap_elements(full = legend)
```


```{r plot.three.quartiles, fig.height=12, fig.width=12}
p1 <- base_plot %+% subset(three_logit_sorted_desc, 
                           prevalence_bins == "(0.035, 0.25]") + 
  ggtitle("Prevalence: (0.035, 0.25]") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")
p2 <- base_plot %+% subset(three_logit_sorted_desc, 
                           prevalence_bins == "(0.25, 0.5]") + 
  ggtitle("Prevalence: (0.25, 0.5]") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")
p3 <- base_plot %+% subset(three_logit_sorted_desc, 
                           prevalence_bins == "(0.5, 0.75]") + 
  ggtitle("Prevalence: (0.5, 0.75]") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")
p4 <- base_plot %+% subset(three_logit_sorted_desc, 
                           prevalence_bins == "(0.75, 0.975]") + 
  ggtitle("Prevalence: (0.75, 0.975]") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")

layout <- c(
  area(1, 1, 4, 1),  # p1: rows 1–4, col 1
  area(5, 1, 8, 1),  # p2: rows 5–8, col 1
  area(1, 2, 3, 2),  # p3: rows 1–3, col 2
  area(4, 2, 8, 2)   # p4: rows 4–8, col 2
)

# Combine plots (no legends in each)
final_plot <- wrap_plots(p1, p2, p3, p4, design = layout)
# final_plot

plot_with_legend <- (
  plot_spacer() /
  legend_plot /
  final_plot
) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.02, 0.08, 1))

# Look at plot :D
plot_with_legend

#ggsave("figures/threemo_logistic_forest_plot.png", plot_with_legend,
#      width = 12, height = 12)
```

## New version where all are on one plot, include prevalence as a second axis

### Three month group 

Sean also was thinking that the OR could be the y-axis, so let's give that a try

```{r three.month.OR.yaxis, fig.width=18, fig.height=7}
OR_plot <- ggplot(three_logit_sorted_desc) +
  geom_point(aes(x = plot_name, y = OR, color = Phylum),
             size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = OR_conf_low, ymax = OR_conf_high,
                    x = plot_name, 
                    color = Phylum),
                width = 0.5, linewidth=1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, alpha = 0.75) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x='', y = "Odds Ratio", color = "Phyla") +
  theme(legend.position = "right", 
        legend.text = element_text(size = 11), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=16)) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = phyla_colors)

prevalence <- ggplot(data=three_logit_sorted_desc, aes(x=plot_name, y=prevalence, group=1)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size=2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red", fill = "pink") + 
  labs(x='', y = "Prevalence") + 
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=16))
```


```{r three.mo.combined, fig.width=25, fig.height=17}
combined <- prevalence / OR_plot + 
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 2)) 
combined
```

```{r save.three.mo.combined}
ggsave("figures/threemo_logistic_forest_plot_horizontal_larger.pdf", combined,
      width = 25, height = 17)
```
